variants.name: Olive Filigree
variants.description: Fine botanical goldwork cut into softly lit lapis.
variants.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: a finished ornamental material plate for the BACK of an Olivia Arcana tarot card. Produce ONE full-bleed portrait texture7:12, approx896x1536, perfectly straight-on orthographic, filling the whole image. Reference image is the REAL card FRONT: match its extraordinarily tactile carved midnight-lapis material, subtle natural ivory, patinated champagne gold and fine material detail. The new BACK must be elegant and rich, with a legible medium-scale motif and exquisite small-scale engraving. The object is a thin tarot card, not a thick slab, tablet, plaque, jewel box, invitation template or app panel. Extremely shallow carved/debossed relief with soft directional light from upper left: fine contours catch light, adjoining recesses stay dark, diffuse mineral body remains dimensional. NO chunky raised metal, thick borders, huge beveled moldings, cartoon gold, glitter or uniformly scattered flecks. Gold lines at most1–2pixels at896pixel width, carefully spaced and finely incised rather than fat cast bars. Blue-black mineral color shifts and occasional grouped pyrite veins, not an all-over cracked ceramic texture. An authored ornamental silhouette occupies around65% of card height, with quiet areas between details. Keep a centered vertical oval pocket approximately28% of card width and30% of height relatively plain midnight lapis; a brand mark will later be typeset into this area, so the pocket is EMPTY of logos, icons, stems, fruit or lettering. No explicit frame around that empty pocket unless specified. Surrounding ornament is allowed to remain tonal ivory-blue in addition to micro-gold, so it reads richly at small sizes despite its thin lines. NO TEXT or logos ANYWHERE. No render shadow outside the card, no tabletop, no perspective, no visible side edge, no outside margin. The perimeter is one finely engraved channel, never a thick picture frame. Direction: Four interlaced olive boughs create a tall symmetrical mandorla around the quiet center. The main flowing stems are ultra-fine incised gold. Slender natural leaves are shallow blue-on-blue intaglio with a very faint ivory-blue light on one edge, not filled gold leaves. At the upper and lower ends the boughs meet in a delicate laced botanical knot. Intricate copperplate leaf-vein hatching. Strong overall botanical silhouette with small areas of velvety mineral quiet. Classical craftsmanship, airy and detailed.
